# Rikka

> A modern Web Components toolkit with fine-grained reactivity based on TC39 Signals. Zero virtual DOM, ~16KB gzip, type-safe, and LLM-friendly. Three published packages: `@takanashi/rikka-signal`, `@takanashi/rikka-dom`, `@takanashi/rikka-elements`.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention. If you're an AI coding agent, start with the umbrella skill below, then load task-specific skills on demand.

## Umbrella skill (start here)

- [rikka](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/rikka/SKILL.md): Orientation — what rikka is, the four LLM-specific footguns, the minimal counter example. Load this first.
- [overview](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/overview/SKILL.md): What rikka is, the three packages, design principles, when to use it.

## Reactive state

- [reactive-state](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/reactive-state/SKILL.md): `signal`, `computed`, `effect`, `untracked`. The TC39-Signals-based reactive primitives.

## DOM

- [dom-creation](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/dom-creation/SKILL.md): `h()`, tag helpers, `h\`` template literal. Creates real DOM elements.
- [signal-binding](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/signal-binding/SKILL.md): Binding signals to text nodes, attributes, template slots. Fine-grained vs coarse-grained.
- [control-flow](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/control-flow/SKILL.md): `For` (lists), `Show` / `When` / `Switch` / `Match` (conditionals).
- [form-binding](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/form-binding/SKILL.md): Two-way binding for `<input>`, `<textarea>`, `<select>`.
- [svg](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/svg/SKILL.md): SVG elements, namespace handling, name-collision tags (`a`, `script`, `style`, `title`).

## Custom elements

- [custom-element](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/custom-element/SKILL.md): `defineElement`, `attributes`, `events`, `methods`, `render` — the full `ElementConfig` reference.
- [shadow-dom-styling](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/shadow-dom-styling/SKILL.md): `css\``, `inlineStyle\``, `adoptStyle`, `:host` selector.
- [template-binding](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/template-binding/SKILL.md): The `template` option of `defineElement` with `{{name}}` / `{{@event}}` syntax.
- [composition](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/composition/SKILL.md): Composable functions + `MyElement.h(...)` to embed a custom element.

## Operations

- [browser-compatibility](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/browser-compatibility/SKILL.md): Browser support matrix and polyfills for Custom Elements / Shadow DOM / CSSStyleSheet.
- [common-pitfalls](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/skills/common-pitfalls/SKILL.md): Cross-cutting mistakes — read this before generating rikka code. Covers the 4 rikka-specific LLM footguns.

## Install via the `skills` CLI

```bash
npx skills add yw662/rikka
```

- [Package READMEs](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/utils): `@takanashi/rikka-signal`, `@takanashi/rikka-dom`, `@takanashi/rikka-elements` — short API summaries with links back to the skills.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/yw662/rikka): Source, issues, examples.
